notes: «عن أبان وَ غَيْرِهِ»: غيره is an unnamed co-transmitter of أبان
«عن أبي جعفر» is written inside the chain after «عن», so it is a narrator (owner ruling 2)
«قَضَى أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ» is the judgment quoted in the words after the chain: the Imam named there is the last link, imam_in_text
